reviews.summary: AKT-EUR appears exposed to a scheduled Kraken order-entry maintenance window later today (October 5, 2026, 09:00–10:00 UTC), which could impair order submissions/modifications during an intraday position. No current Akash exploit, chain outage, or AKT-specific delisting was identified.
materialRisks: Kraken scheduled order-entry maintenance on October 5, 2026 from 09:00–10:00 UTC: order submissions/modifications may be rejected and API latency may rise, creating execution/exit risk if the position remains open into that window. ([status.kraken.com](https://status.kraken.com/?utm_source=openai))

facts.fact: Akash Network released node version v2.1.2 on September 23, 2026, including Pyth router-governance rotation fixes; the release itself does not indicate an active incident. ([github.com](https://github.com/akash-network/node/releases?utm_source=openai))

Akash’s official 2026 roadmap lists Burn-Mint Equilibrium and CosmWasm functionality as completed on March 23, 2026; no new official project announcement in the last week was found indicating an imminent disruptive protocol event. ([akash.network](https://akash.network/roadmap/2026/?utm_source=openai))

Current supply data indicates ongoing AKT issuance rather than a large imminent vesting cliff; third-party chain-derived data reported 22,698.79 AKT issued on October 4, 2026. ([netsupply.org](https://netsupply.org/tokens/akash-network?utm_source=openai))
